recommendation: Keep the empty external-repo audit commit. No FHIR-core follow-up is needed unless the work group later decides to migrate the SDC shortText extension into core or the FHIR Extension Pack.
issue_request: FHIR-17911 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core Questionnaire issue asking for a short title for each question, either as a new Questionnaire.item.title element or as a standard questionnaire-title extension. The approved resolution was to add an SDC extension for short question text to the advanced rendering profile and include notes recommending that QuestionnaireResponse reflect the short text when that is what the user saw.
initial_application: No FHIR-core implementation commit was found. Jira cites Git#89b578f, and GitHub resolves that to HL7/sdc commit 89b578f65802d7c954883b2c4f58d0d1ae9b50b3, which added shortText extension content, examples, rendering guidance, and SDC source files.
additional_context: Questionnaire is active in core source/fhir.ini, and current core Questionnaire.item.text remains the primary item text. The related FHIR-17910 group-heading guidance is already present in the core item.text comment but is a separate applied issue. The current SDC package hl7.fhir.uv.sdc#4.0.0 publishes StructureDefinition/sdc-questionnaire-shortText for Questionnaire.item and ElementDefinition with valueString and the expected QuestionnaireResponse usage note.
reconciliation: No core source change was made. The issue belongs to the SDC implementation guide repository/package, and the requested extension is already present there; adding a core element or duplicating the extension in core would not match the recorded resolution.

related_jiras.note: The seed cites this group-title guidance issue. It was applied separately in core and explains the current Questionnaire.item.text comment, but it does not require deciding FHIR-17910 in this seed.
